fields.Name: ORD-36 - Progress Measurement
fields.Description: Percentage-of-completion revenue recognition by attested catch-up (AIDP-26, golive #241, plan Part F, D90). Proves the cumulative arithmetic ties exactly at 100% with a backward slide posting a negative delta through the mirrored entry, that a POC line books to Deferred Revenue and stages no recognition at booking, that Preview writes nothing, that a posted observation is immutable, that an unchanged percent is a success with no entry, and that a non-POC line or a backdated observation is refused.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: 40/70/55/100 posts four entries summing to the line with the third negative and the last landing the odd cent, and RecognizedToDateAfter agrees with the ledger at each step; a POC line books Dr AR / Cr Deferred with no releases; Preview leaves observation rows and journal entries unchanged; a posted observation refuses update (trigger); an unchanged percent writes an observation but no entry; a straight-line line and an observation dated before the last posted one are refused with a reason.
